text: Handling deadlines well depends on good time management. Start by planning your tasks and setting a clear schedule. Prioritization is also important: focus on the most urgent and important work first, and leave less critical tasks for later. Scope management helps you avoid taking on too much, so be realistic about what you can finish on time. Finally, communication matters. If a problem appears, tell your team or teacher early instead of waiting until the last minute. By combining these skills, you can reduce stress and meet your deadlines more successfully.
